items.prompt: Which organelles does a mature plant leaf cell contain?
What is the function of the rough endoplasmic reticulum?
items.answer: It is studded with ribosomes and folds proteins for secretion.
choices: It is studded with ribosomes and folds proteins for secretion.

items.prompt: Name the bond that joins two amino acids in a polypeptide.
A protein is heated and loses its three-dimensional shape while its amino acid sequence stays intact. What is this change called?
Why does a plant cell need mitochondria when it already has chloroplasts?
items.answer: It respires day and night to release energy, and only mitochondria carry out respiration.
choices: It respires day and night to release energy, and only mitochondria carry out respiration.
It does not need them; chloroplasts do all the energy work.
Mitochondria are only for storage in plant cells.
